summary: The Beachmaker, Autograph Collection Residences brings Marriott's Autograph Collection to Madeira Beach: 161 hotel residences plus 10 branded penthouse residences on a 2.5-acre resort site, about a mile from John's Pass. Owners enjoy two pools, restaurants and bars, event venues and concierge service, with professional resort management by Davidson Hospitality and Marriott booking channels. Early buyers are welcomed into The Founders Club.

faqs.q: What is The Beachmaker in Madeira Beach?
faqs.a: The Beachmaker, Autograph Collection Residences is a Marriott Autograph Collection branded condo-hotel at 15000 Madeira Way, Madeira Beach, Florida, with 161 hotel residences and 10 branded penthouse residences. It has a target opening of 2029.

faqs.q: How much does a residence at The Beachmaker cost?
faqs.a: Pricing ranges from approximately $837,000 to $4.4 million.

faqs.q: Can I rent my Beachmaker residence?
faqs.a: Yes. Residences participate in nightly resort rentals through mandatory resort management and Marriott Autograph Collection booking channels. Self-management is not permitted. Owners receive up to 90 owner-use days per year.

faqs.q: What is the owner revenue share at The Beachmaker?
faqs.a: The incentive offering is a 60% owner revenue share, subject to the management agreement. A conversation with the management company can be arranged for income projections.

faqs.q: What deposit is required to reserve at The Beachmaker?
faqs.a: A $5,000 initial reservation deposit with a 15-day right of rescission. Select Founders Club residences require only a 20% deposit placed in escrow.
The Founders Club is for The Beachmaker's earliest owners and includes first selection of residences, a luxury furniture package and full access to resort amenities.
